units.translation: ⟦1⟧ Homer 8 735, here with accusative of the whole and of the part as at 88 ⟦2⟧. But the verse has no rhythm, which is restored in various ways: ⟦3⟧ Hermann, ⟦4⟧. ⟦5⟧. ⟦6⟧ Dindorf, in which, however, ⟦7⟧ (miseria aerumna ⟦8⟧) is no improvement for ⟦9⟧; if one inserts ⟦10⟧, one need not rearrange: ⟦11⟧ (⟦12⟧) ⟦13⟧, and one can attach ⟦14⟧, which is a quite unsuitable object for ⟦15⟧. Nowhere in Aeschylus is ⟦16⟧ unambiguously 'anger'.
who slips under me, what pain in my sides

⟦1⟧ A. also has ⟦2⟧. 873, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧. At V. 815 ⟦5⟧ (⟦6⟧. 912) is a happy correction by L. Dindorf; the construction ⟦7⟧ (take away) ⟦8⟧ is otherwise unattested, but seems not impossible, cf. on 213, where I write ⟦9⟧. The ⟦10⟧ (as nothing) is in any case common to the passages.
you counted as nothing the pledges of Hera Teleia and Zeus

The speech has an even milder character than the previous one; for the Erinyes too have at least not repeated their threat, frightened by the reference to Zeus' omnipotence. With ⟦1⟧ there is particular connection to 840, with ⟦2⟧ to ⟦3⟧ 838, likewise with ⟦4⟧ . . ⟦5⟧ 848 f.; finally with 851 ⟦6⟧ yet to ⟦7⟧ 838, see above. ⟦8⟧ is similar to ⟦9⟧; exact parallels are lacking, but Paley cites ⟦10⟧: ⟦11⟧, Blaydes ⟦12⟧ ⟦13⟧ (before that ⟦14⟧ . . ⟦15⟧).
I will join my wrath with you
having come to a foreign land
to share one's wrath with someone
it is fitting for you to bear my wrath
848 seems well emended by Wakefield, even if the scholion ⟦1⟧ does not exactly provide proof for ⟦2⟧.
851 ⟦1⟧ in the tragedians only here; moreover, the patriotic pride of the Athenian begins to show itself.

The ⟦1⟧ 855 denote the Erechtheion and the Acropolis; the sanctuary of the Eumenides lay on the slope of the Areopagus that faced the Acropolis, U. Köhler Hermes VI, 100. After 855 a lacuna is rightly assumed, since ⟦2⟧ 857 has no reference and is not well emended either in ⟦3⟧ (Ahrens) or in ⟦4⟧ (Pauw); with ⟦5⟧ the sequence after ⟦6⟧ and the accumulation of genitives is disturbing.
